fields.FIR_Description: It was alleged that unidentified persons allegedly damaged a parked car of the complainant near Iniyan Colony Apartment Complex at night. The matter was brought to Tiruppur Central PS on 2026-09-06, while the incident was placed on 2026-09-04 at about 22:30. Praveen Shankar approached Tiruppur Central PS to report the matter and can be reached on 9000000131. The complaint mentions Anand Muthu, who was reportedly contacted on 9000000280, in connection with the events. The complainant mentioned photographs and CCTV footage.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Property reportedly defaced late at night.
fields.Keywords: vandalism, property damage, suspect, mobile number, apartment complex, CCTV, night, photograph
